<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/associates/{associateId}/utilization"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Measured task time vs. measured idle time for one associate, plus the still-running open-gap contribution when that associate is idle right now. Always returns 200, including a zero-count result for an associate this service has never observed.

  as={"h2"}

Defaults to 1 hour when omitted or malformed.\n","schema":{"type":"string","example":"1h"}}]}
>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"The associate utilization read model","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","description":"Idle-gap / utilization read model for either one TaskType (fleet-wide) or one associate, over a trailing window. taskType and associateId are mutually exclusive -- whichever endpoint served the request populates its own identifying field and omits the other.\n","properties":{"taskType":{"type":"string","enum":["PICK","PACK","SLAM"],"description":"Mirrors fulfillment-execution's task.Type enum exactly.","title":"TaskType"},"associateId":{"type":"string"},"associates":{"type":"integer","description":"The distinct associate count contributing to this result. Always 1 for a per-associate result; for a task-type result, the distinct-associate count over the window (0 for a never-observed task type).\n"},"windowSeconds":{"type":"integer","format":"int64"},"taskSeconds":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","description":"Summed measured task duration over the window."},"idleSeconds":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","description":"Summed recorded (closed) idle-gap seconds over the window -- never includes openGapSeconds.\n"},"openGapSeconds":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","description":"The still-running idle time for a subject idle right now: now minus their last known activity, clamped to the window. Computed at READ time, never persisted (see the idleness ADR's \"Trailing idleness\" limitation). Zero when the subject is not currently idle, and always zero on the task-type endpoint: an open gap belongs to one associate, so it is only reported by the per-associate endpoint.\n"},"utilizationPct":{"type":"number","format":"double","nullable":true,"description":"100 * taskSeconds / (taskSeconds + idleSeconds + openGapSeconds). Null when nothing was observed in the window -- never a fabricated number.\n"}},"title":"Utilization"}}}}}}
